name: Lifestack
tagline: Keep the plan. Get help with the work inside it.
metaTitle: Lifestack Alternative: An AI Assistant for Your Whole Day
metaDescription: Looking for a Lifestack alternative? GAIA handles the email, calendar and tasks behind your day, runs workflows and works from chat apps, web and desktop.
whyPeopleLook: Lifestack is good at something few apps attempt: pacing your day around how rested you are, using data from your wearable. People look for an alternative when planning is no longer the bottleneck. The plan is fine, but the inbox still needs replies, meetings still need booking and the same chores repeat every week, and a planner does not do that work for them.
painPoints: A plan for the day, but no help with the email and meetings inside it
Few work integrations beyond calendars, Todoist and Trello
Proprietary, with no way to self-host or read the code
gaiaReplaces: Copying tasks out of email into your planner by hand
Booking meetings yourself once the plan shows a free slot
Repeating the same weekly chores by hand
Checking several apps to see what needs attention
gaiaAdvantages: Triages Gmail and Outlook and drafts replies
Workflows on a schedule or triggered by Gmail, Calendar, Slack and GitHub
Integrations with Slack, Notion, GitHub, Linear, Asana, HubSpot and more
Reachable from iMessage, WhatsApp, Telegram, Slack and Discord
migrationSteps: Connect the Google Calendar or Outlook calendar Lifestack planned into
Connect Gmail or Outlook and your task tool to GAIA
Tell GAIA your working hours and the times you focus best
Set up a scheduled workflow that sends you a morning summary

faqs.question: What is the best Lifestack alternative?
faqs.answer: If you want another planner driven by wearable data, few apps match Lifestack. If you want help with the work that fills your day, such as email, meetings, tasks and recurring chores, GAIA is a closer fit.

faqs.question: Can GAIA plan around my sleep like Lifestack?
faqs.answer: No. GAIA does not read wearable or health data. You can tell it when you focus best and it will plan around that on request, but it does not adjust to your sleep or recovery.

faqs.question: How much does GAIA cost?
faqs.answer: GAIA's hosted service is a paid subscription per person, with Pro at ${{PRO_MONTHLY_PRICE}}/month, and GAIA Enterprise is priced on request. The code is source-available under the PolyForm Noncommercial license, so self-hosting is free for personal, noncommercial use, and for-profit organizations self-host under an enterprise license (contact the GAIA team).

faqs.question: How do I switch from Lifestack to GAIA?
faqs.answer: Connect the calendar Lifestack used, add your email and task tool, tell GAIA your working hours and focus times, and set up a morning summary workflow.
